items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Joe Avery; the interviewer mentions Joe Avery in the context of Duke Ellington's history.

ctx.x: I know Black Happy was the drummer. Jack Carey played trombone. Who else played? I don't know who was playing trumpet. Lee, yeah, Lee Collin played with him for a while. I can't think of the bass player. I used to work also with Duke and Forstay. You ever heard of Trombone Play by the name of Forstay?

And Duke and his two brothers? The brother played trumpet? Yeah. He used to work with Joe Avery and Wilbur Tilma when I first came in 1945. He died. I have a private recording of the mother's play, you know, in Mayden. For me, just for something to remember him by when I was a young lady. He played nice.
Well, yeah, he used to be the nice of the nightclub.
